title: Docs: Route tagging + Usage Insights overview (cost drivers by route)
author: Wei Chen
body: Summary: Adds a new docs page explaining Usage Insights (cost drivers by route/model) plus a dedicated guide for setting a stable `route` identifier via SDKs or gateway/header. Includes updated screenshots from console staging and an FAQ section addressing common “invoice vs console mismatch” confusion. Context: This is the docs deliverable for the In-console usage insights project. Customers and Sales/CS have repeatedly asked for route-level cost attribution and exportable reports; we need clear guidance on (1) how to tag routes, (2) naming/cadinality best practices, and (3) how to interpret cost numbers and deltas. See ENG-8431 and PM-612; support background in SUP-18420 and SUP-18441. What’s included: 1) New docs page: “Usage Insights (Cost Drivers)”. Covers what data is shown (cost, tokens, cache impact, latency/error rate), dimensions (route + model), filters (time range, env, region, org/project, deployment mode), and how to use Route list vs Route detail. Includes a short ‘What changed vs prior period’ explanation and notes on freshness. 2) New docs page: “Route tagging”. Explains canonical route definition and hierarchy (SDK-provided preferred; gateway-derived fallback; `Unknown route` behavior). Provides recommendations to keep cardinality bounded: route should represent a stable endpoint or product feature (e.g., `chat.search`, `support.summarize`), must not include user IDs / request IDs / freeform strings, and should be <= 80 chars using `[a-zA-Z0-9._/-]`. 3) SDK snippets: Python/TypeScript examples using the new `route` option, plus an HTTP example showing `X-Redwood-Route` for teams using custom clients/gateways. Notes that route tagging should be set at request time and consistent across retries. 4) Screenshots: Updated screenshots from staging for Route list table and Route detail model breakdown. These are included as static assets with alt text and captions. 5) FAQ / Troubleshooting: Adds an FAQ section focused on cost mismatch and missing route tags (e.g., why `Unknown route` can dominate). Includes a simple checklist to reconcile: confirm time range + timezone, allow for metering delay, check project scope, check cached token accounting, and verify route tagging is enabled across all services/SDKs. Also includes a note on late-arriving data and why weekly invoice totals may not equal near-real-time console totals. Screenshots added: - Route list: `docs/assets/console/usage-insights/route-list.png` - Route detail: `docs/assets/console/usage-insights/route-detail-model-breakdown.png` - Export modal: `docs/assets/console/usage-insights/export-report.png` (caption clarifies limits and audit logging occurs server-side; detailed export schema docs will be in follow-up PR-819). Key copy decisions: - Terminology: “route” is defined as ‘developer-defined identifier for a request pathway/endpoint’ (not necessarily an HTTP path). We explicitly differentiate “HTTP path” vs “route tag”. - We call out that route tagging is optional but strongly recommended; without it, costs roll up into `Unknown route`. - We use “Usage Insights” as the product name and “Cost drivers” as the page subtitle for searchability. Files changed (high level): - `site/docs/console/usage-insights.md` (new) - `site/docs/guides/route-tagging.md` (new) - `site/docs/api/request-metadata.md` (updated to mention `X-Redwood-Route`) - `site/docs/sdks/typescript.md` (updated snippet) - `site/docs/sdks/python.md` (updated snippet) - `site/docs/troubleshooting/cost-and-usage.md` (updated FAQ entries + links) - `site/static/assets/console/usage-insights/*` (new screenshots) - `site/sidebars.js` (nav placement under Console → Usage) - `site/docs/_partials/route-tagging-best-practices.md` (new partial shared by both pages) Commit summary: 1) docs(usage-insights): add overview page + navigation 2) docs(route): add route tagging guide + SDK/header examples 3) docs(troubleshooting): add cost mismatch FAQ and `Unknown route` guidance 4) chore(assets): add staging screenshots + captions/alt text Review notes / resolutions: - Design (Tessa) requested improved table screenshot readability and consistent highlighting; updated screenshots and added callouts in captions. - PM (Paula) requested we clarify that “what changed” compares to the prior equal-length period; updated copy and added example. - DevEx (Monica) requested we align parameter naming with SDKs (`route` option) and keep header name consistent; validated against SDK PRs and kept `X-Redwood-Route`. - Support (Dev) requested a short section on `Unknown route` root causes + how to fix; added troubleshooting bullets and linked to SUP-18441 pattern. CI: `docs-build` (pass), `lint` (pass), `link-check` (pass). Release notes: Customer-facing docs published ahead of beta enablement; links will be included in Console release notes draft and in-app help panel once the feature flag expands. Follow-ups: - PR-819 will document export schemas/limits and audit logging details in more depth. - Once Private/VPC doc set is updated, we should add a short note about route tagging for gateway deployments in VPC mode (currently covered briefly in the HTTP header example).
release_notes: Adds new docs pages for Usage Insights (cost drivers) and Route tagging, including screenshots and FAQ about invoice vs console cost mismatches; updates SDK snippets and request metadata header docs.
